# AURIS 0.9.1

Maintenance update for road calculations, façade receptors and model editing.

- Explicit Day/Night LAeq prediction from one LA10,18h input, using the revised TRL end correction after combining native CRTN contributions by road type.
- Faster CRTN contour calculations using batched terrain sampling and parallel receiver batches; improved progress reporting and active-slice L10 validation.
- Road node editing, snapping and Shift-branch junction creation; junction clipping for carriageway edges, lanes and central reservations.
- Shift-click places attached incident receptors on the façade; Shift–Option/Alt-click places them 1 m outward. Host-wall contact does not block front-side sound; rear-side screening is retained.
- Compact, zoom-independent receptor result badges on Option/Alt-click; Shift-click remains multi-selection.
- Batch building colours, medium-weight building labels above geometry, and area-centred building handles.
- Independent terrain-point visibility and selection; reduced editor hover and 3D scene preparation overhead.
- Deferred 3D inspector commits to avoid destroying active text fields during Return-key handling.

- Corrected 24-hour AADT/AADF flow handling: the previous hourly-equivalent multiplier could turn 21,000 vehicles/day into 428,757 Q18h when the legacy profile held 100%. Daily counts now use an explicit 06:00–24:00 percentage. AADF and AADT share the same calculation; AADF shows its 1:1 AADT equivalent. The default 100% is clearly identified as a conservative assumption. Existing daily-count projects require recalculation.
- Traffic count and AADT/AADF selector share a row; the resulting CRTN Q18h is shown directly below the period share.
- Frame all now frames the placed acoustic objects. Calculate expands an unlocked, cropped view to include model objects; explicitly locked or defined export frames retain their requested extent.


## Existing operating restrictions

The v0.9.0 REPORT_SAFE-only scope remains: production report-quality calculations, direct 0.5 m Calculated Grid and explicitly calculated receptors at assessment locations. Interpolated Raster, Scalar Field, SmartSmooth, coarse interpolated contours and Live Preview remain outside report-grade acceptance. Full contour stages B–G remain incomplete. This maintenance release does not expand standards certification or report-grade acceptance. Automated macOS accessibility inspection remains an unresolved separate limitation.
